focus: D3 traceability - spec_code, checklist_evidence and lead-sanctioned contract conflict

findingDetails.title: The deep-review contract calls the config read-only after init while its own workflow flips the config status at the terminal step
findingDetails.evidence: SKILL.md:392 NEVER rule 6 says deep-review-config.json is read-only after initialization; deep-review-auto.yaml:2322-2325 defines step_update_config_status as edit of the config with set_field status complete. The lead's binding ruling resolves it for the workflow step and invites this wording gap. Failure scenario: an executor following the NEVER literally leaves a completed run at running/initialized (resume readers see it as unfinished), while one performing the flip has violated its given contract text.
findingDetails.recommendation: Scope the NEVER to review parameters (immutable after init) and name the terminal status flip as the workflow's own step.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read both sides at their exact lines; the lead ruling names the same two sides.
